a_enqueue_overhead.rule: enqueueOnlyMs - structuralMs <= structuralMs * 0.05 (i.e. enqueue overhead ≤5% on top of pure structural)

b_pending_eq_files.rule: pending == files_in_db (every indexed file gets exactly one pending row)

c_embed_rate.rule: 65 ms <= perFileMs <= 100 ms (~81 ms ±20%), and processed == files_in_db (no failed rows left)

notes.fix_during_measurement: Pre-fix run (task nC1hJ9) showed enqueue_overhead=666% because `--with-embeddings` (no --wait) still spawned the worker via EmbeddingRunner.notifyEnqueued, and worker_threads.Worker as an active handle prevented the CLI process from exiting. Fixed in src/index.ts runEmbeddingPipeline: skip EmbeddingRunner.forDatabase + notifyEnqueued entirely when wait=false. Post-fix run (task EjgSVx) shows enqueue_overhead=-2.24% (noise) and round-2 terminal state pending=11491.
notes.methodology_correction: 1-4-2's '~50s' drupal baseline was a stale reference number from a different engine (likely rust-hybrid). Typescript engine on drupal measures 147-153s. Verdict (a) is therefore computed as same-engine self-control (round 1 vs round 2), not against an external baseline.
notes.expected_embedded_files: 1-4-2's '11 494' was on-disk files (11 501) minus empty (7). The files table on this fixture has 11 491 rows (additional ~10 lost to .gitignore'd etc). Use files_in_db as SoT.
